hide.name: Hide
hide.tip: When an element is hidden, it and its descendant elements (which actually still exist) will no longer be rendered.

disable-pointer-events.name: Disable Pointer Events
disable-pointer-events.tip: Disable automatic triggering of all pointer events (including mouse-down events) for this element and its descendant elements.

enable-pointer-events.name: Enable Pointer Events
enable-pointer-events.tip: Restore automatic triggering of element pointer events.

skip-pointer-events.name: Skip Pointer Events
skip-pointer-events.tip: Disable automatic triggering of all pointer events for this element, but not for its descendant elements.

move-to-first.name: Move to First
move-to-first.tip: Move the element to the first position in the list of its parent's child elements (always obscured by other child elements, equivalent to being placed at the bottom).

move-to-last.name: Move to Last
move-to-last.tip: Move the element to the last position in the list of its parent's child elements (always obscuring other children, equivalent to being placed on top).
